title: KLEIN MESH: House1+House2 LAN = bottle interior; WAN = I/O surface; Tor = butthole; graphene/phone = bidirectional later

the_thesis.evolve_lan_to_sporegate_to_wan: eastGate lives on House LAN. sporeGate (192.168.4.3 / 10.13.37.2) is the renamed mesh node that WAS confused with northGate — it is the SPORE: local fruiting body that releases to the wider mycelium. WAN (golgi/cloudflared/CDN) is how spores leave the bottle without tearing it.
the_thesis.klein: a Klein bottle has no separable inside/outside. House1 + House2 meshes are the continuous interior surface. The WAN is not 'outside the LAN' — it is an I/O SURFACE folded onto the same bottle. Traffic that leaves through Cloudflare re-enters as clones, pollen, DMCA reactions — the fold.
the_thesis.tor_as_butthole: Tor is the exhaust orifice — the coccyx/tailbone of the network. Not the mouth (that is CDN/HTTP). Not the skin (LAN). The butthole: one-way-preferring egress for waste heat, anonymity exhaust, and traffic that should not re-enter as identity. Like SEO/RSS in tailbone-exhaust.json — pressure out. Tor = intentional cloaca for sensitive I/O.
the_thesis.graphene_phone_later: grapheneGate (Pixel 8a / GrapheneOS) and/or a mobile phone become a BIDIRECTIONAL pore — not just exhaust. When linked, the bottle breathes both ways on cellular: field I/O without House WiFi. That completes the animal — mouth + cloaca + mobile spiracle.
the_thesis.aco: Ant Colony Optimization: mesh routing learns by pheromone. WG keepalives + songBird gossip + clone trails deposit scent. Good paths thicken (LAN 0.2ms). Bad paths evaporate (dead SSH). ACO proceeds on the Klein surface — ants don't need a map of inside vs outside.
